card.name: The word of after more or less
card.fires_on: The word "of" right after "more", "less" or "least" when it introduces a thing or share (more of the, less of an). General web and medical text.

modes.label: Quantity before the
modes.description: "of" after more or less, followed by "the" and a noun, meaning a larger or smaller part.
modes.example: to view more<< of>> the material or you can resize the window

modes.label: Degree before a/an
modes.description: "of" after more, less or least in a phrase describing what kind or how much of something it is.
modes.example: load times became less<< of>> an issue as optical drives became faster.
